g.text: PCA and covariance use fixed conventions recorded in the stage-1 analysis. The single participant was the highest reported performer in all four sessions.

g.text: Measurement, reference, artifact, fatigue, and decoder recalibration effects remain possible. These plots cannot isolate biological learning or learning preservation.
